<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cardGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#353843"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#181A20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>

  <!-- subtle decorative blobs -->
  <circle cx="322" cy="116" r="88" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="171" r="64" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  <circle cx="324" cy="704" r="124" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="676" r="70" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="28" font-family="SF Pro Text, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(306,18)">
      <line x1="0" y1="14" x2="0" y2="8" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="14" x2="6" y2="6" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="14" x2="12" y2="4" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="14" x2="18" y2="2" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="35" cy="9" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="32" y1="9" x2="38" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <path d="" fill="none"/>
      <rect x="54" y="4" width="24" height="11" rx="2.7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="56" y="6" width="18" height="7.3" rx="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="78" y="7" width="1.3" height="4" rx="0.7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Top nav -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,71 26,79 34,87" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="79" x2="47" y2="79" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="58" y="84" font-family="Poppins, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Add Payment Method</text>
    <text x="312" y="84" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Secure</text>
  </g>

  <!-- info banner -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="98" width="350" height="56" rx="16" fill="#262A34" opacity="0.95"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="126" r="13" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="42" y="131" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">i</text>
    <text x="70" y="121" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Use a card that supports online payments</text>
    <text x="70" y="138" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#D6D9DD">You can save a Visa, Mastercard, or debit card for future checkout.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main form card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="170" width="350" height="456" rx="24" fill="#262A34"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Card brand and illustration -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="208" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#A5F59C">Supported cards</text>
    <rect x="282" y="188" width="64" height="40" rx="12" fill="#353843"/>
    <circle cx="304" cy="208" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.95"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="208" r="10" fill="#FFDD72" opacity="0.95"/>
    <text x="292" y="211" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Visa</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="44" y="236" width="302" height="156" rx="18" fill="url(#cardGrad)"/>
    <rect x="44" y="236" width="302" height="156" rx="18" fill="none" stroke="#3A3D46" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- faux card preview -->
    <rect x="62" y="254" width="42" height="28" rx="6" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <rect x="68" y="262" width="30" height="4" rx="2" fill="#200745" opacity="0.75"/>
    <rect x="68" y="269" width="20" height="4" rx="2" fill="#200745" opacity="0.55"/>

    <text x="62" y="318" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#D6D9DD">CARD NUMBER</text>
    <text x="62" y="346" font-family="Poppins, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">••••  ••••  ••••  8421</text>

    <text x="62" y="372" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#D6D9DD">CARD HOLDER</text>
    <text x="62" y="393" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sophia Bennett</text>

    <text x="250" y="372" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#D6D9DD">EXPIRES</text>
    <text x="250" y="393" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">09/28</text>

    <circle cx="296" cy="269" r="18" fill="#FBA3FF" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="314" cy="269" r="18" fill="#FFDD72" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="284" y="274" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">MC</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Field section -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="426" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Card number</text>
    <rect x="44" y="436" width="302" height="48" rx="14" fill="#181A20"/>
    <text x="62" y="466" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">4242 4242 4242 4242</text>

    <text x="44" y="508" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Expiry date</text>
    <rect x="44" y="518" width="142" height="48" rx="14" fill="#181A20"/>
    <text x="62" y="548" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">09 / 28</text>

    <text x="204" y="508" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CVV</text>
    <rect x="204" y="518" width="142" height="48" rx="14" fill="#181A20"/>
    <text x="222" y="548" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">123</text>

    <text x="44" y="584" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#D6D9DD">3 or 4 digit security code on the back of your card.</text>

    <!-- checkbox row -->
    <rect x="44" y="598" width="18" height="18" rx="5" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <polyline points="48,607 52,611 59,602" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="612" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Save card for faster checkout</text>
  </g>

  <!-- summary mini card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="642" width="350" height="86" rx="20" fill="#353843"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="685" r="17" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="44" y="690" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">$</text>
    <text x="74" y="676" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">New payment method</text>
    <text x="74" y="694" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#D6D9DD">Visa ending in 8421 • Expires 09/28</text>
    <text x="290" y="683" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFDD72">$0.00</text>
    <text x="290" y="700" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#D6D9DD">No charge now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom save button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="742" width="350" height="52" rx="26" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="195" y="775" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Save Payment Method</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="804" width="390" height="40" fill="#262A34"/>
    <!-- active home -->
    <g transform="translate(26,812)">
      <polygon points="12,2 2,10 22,10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="6" y="10" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="12" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- search -->
    <g transform="translate(104,812)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="14" y1="14" x2="20" y2="20" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#D6D9DD">Search</text>
    </g>
    <!-- add -->
    <g transform="translate(176,808)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#A5F59C"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="10" x2="18" y2="26" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="18" x2="26" y2="18" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Add</text>
    </g>
    <!-- cards -->
    <g transform="translate(256,812)">
      <rect x="4" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="4" y1="10" x2="24" y2="10" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="14" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#D6D9DD">Cards</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g transform="translate(330,812)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="5" fill="#D6D9DD"/>
      <rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="8" rx="4" fill="#D6D9DD"/>
      <text x="12" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#D6D9DD">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
